note: Every abbreviation and technical term used in the package docs, defined at the register it is used. Internal method/version identifiers use semantic names only (e.g. shared_program_basis_v1, context_token_trunk, device_centered_target).

terms.definition: One library x cell-line screen, e.g. zel024_hek293. The 8 predictive contexts are the package's unit of measurement organization.
One combinatorial chemistry library (a fixed building-block vocabulary and position scheme), screened in one or more cell lines.
One chemical piece in the combinatorial assembly vocabulary. Public, opaque identifiers of the form BB_##########; structures are not in this package.
One building block placed at one recipe position, e.g. bb0=BB_2085420374. The pooled unit of grammar-level analysis.
Which building block sits at which position (bb0-bb4) of a compound's assembly. core/recipes.parquet.
One assembly site in a recipe (bb0..bb4). Position sets differ between libraries.
The public compound identifier (CPD_############), the join key for every per-compound table.
The very small well that holds a few cells during measurement; the physical unit of the screens.
A physical measurement batch of nanowells. Device effects are removed by per-device mean centering.
Raw UMI counts summed over the wells of one compound x device combination.
Unique molecular identifier; the per-gene molecule count unit of the raw data.
Counts scaled to 10,000 per profile (counts per 10k), then log(1+x) transformed; the normalization applied to every profile.
Subtracting each device's across-compound mean profile; removes shared abundance shape and additive device shift.
How many reads a measurement received; couples into expression and is handled per context by a registered depth layer.

The per-context adjustment for sequencing depth: within_compound_depth_standardization_v1 (zel024_hek293, zel039_aec7), context_covariate_depth_adjustment_v1 (zel031_a549, zel028_hek293, zel028_a549), none for the three newer contexts.
Read-depth strata of compounds; zel039 similarity analyses use nulls matched on these tiers.
Highly variable gene; per-gene variance ranking used to select the harmonized panel.
The shared 6,000-gene panel all contexts are placed on, defined by core/surfaces/harmonized_6000_genes.parquet.
The full-width pseudobulk gene index space. gene_index in the panel file refers to it; symbols come only from the panel file.
panel_position: column 0-5999 in every harmonized surface. gene_index: that gene's raw position in the 46,944-gene space.
One of 32 coordinated gene-expression patterns shared across all contexts; the columns of the shared basis. Written P01..P32.
The (programs x genes) non-negative loading matrix defining the programs; pinned as shared_program_basis_v1 (k=32) and shared_program_basis_k12_v1 (k=12).
How strongly a compound's measured response expresses a program; each compound is a 32-number usage vector per context.
The 32-dimensional coordinate system of usages; one coordinate system across all 8 contexts.
Semi-nonnegative matrix factorization: gene loadings constrained non-negative, usage coordinates free-sign.
Free-sign least-squares projection of a context-scaled surface onto the pinned basis.
The number of shared programs in a basis (32 shipped, 12 companion).
One of five fixed compound groups: fold = SHA256(public_compound_id) mod 5. Basis and reference model were fit with fold 0 held out; train on folds 1-4, evaluate on fold 0.
Evaluation split holding out compounds by the SHA256-mod-5 fold rule.
Evaluation split holding out entire building blocks, so test compounds contain a block never seen in training.
Linear agreement between two measurements: 0 = none, 1 = perfect.
Mean per-compound Pearson correlation: Pearson computed per compound between predicted and measured gene-space profiles, then averaged.
Pearson between predicted and measured usage coordinates computed per program across compounds, averaged over the 32 programs.
Pearson correlation computed on ranks; robust to monotone distortion.
Angle-based similarity between two vectors; 1 = identical direction, 0 = orthogonal.
What the data look like with no real signal; marks the chance level for a score.
A null built by shuffling labels or pairings and recomputing the statistic.
The correlation obtained after shuffling the compound-to-feature pairing.
A null of random compound sets matched in size and read-depth tier; required for zel039 similarity analyses.
A permissive null under which many candidates pass; specificity then lives in the match's rank and identity, not the p-value.
Distance of a statistic from its null mean, in null standard deviations.
Fraction of null draws at least as extreme as the observed statistic.
Benjamini-Hochberg false-discovery-rate adjusted p-value across a candidate family.
Correlation between two random halves of a compound's measurements, estimating how much of the signal repeats.
Extrapolates a half-data reliability to full-data reliability.
Strong enough to prioritize follow-up decisions: every fold/seed cell above its null, effects stable across perturbations of the analysis.
Prioritization material only: ranked leads to re-rank with your own priors, expected to contain false positives.
Producing test-ready leads with stated nulls and kill/confirm experiments; not confirmatory evidence.
Defined at the recipe level in a library with pooled per-compound measurement: 'these building blocks have this effect', not a per-compound claim.
core/ layers are measured; model outputs, y_pred_z arrays, and grammar_level rows are predictions or recipe-level expectations, labeled where they ship.
A compound measured in one well; zel028 contexts are singleton-dominated and support pooled/level-level reads only.
Structure-activity relationship: how biological effect changes with chemical structure (here, with building-block composition).
Compounds sharing building blocks at two positions whose measured profiles form a coherent series.
Mean pairwise cosine similarity of a compound set's measured program profiles.
How quickly phenotype decays as chemistry moves away from a candidate set; falloff = within-set coherence minus ring-1 correlation.
Chemical-similarity bins around a candidate set; ring 1 = the chemically nearest non-members.
Similarity of a series' signature to series sharing one block; high coherence with low sibling similarity marks the sharpest SAR.
The overall ranking of a chemotype series within its context (composite_score order).
A lead where multiple independent evidence lines converge on a named control's measured phenotype; confidence tier A.
A: anchor-validated. B: strong pooled signal, nulls addressed, limited independence. C: triage.
The concrete wet-lab test that would kill or confirm a lead; stated per anchor lead.
Controlled vocabulary on hypothesis rows: weak_null, singleton, triage_grade, low_coverage.
Stable hypothesis identifier, consistent across package versions.
Mechanism of action; the control panel's annotation class.
Field of view: one microscope image of one well region.
A fixed-length numeric vector summarizing an image, produced by a pretrained image model.
A pretrained convolutional image network; its 2,048-dimensional per-compound embedding means ship in the imaging annex.
A pretrained image-text model; its 1,024-dimensional per-compound embedding means ship in the imaging annex.
A compact numeric description of one detected object in an image (zel039 ships 448-dimensional per-detection latents).
A stained imaging channel measuring a specific target (DAPI, p21, p62, phalloidin, BRD4, ConA). Markers are prediction targets, never input features.
DNA/nuclei stain.
Cell-cycle arrest marker channel (zel024 panel).
Autophagy adaptor marker channel (zel024 panel only).
Actin cytoskeleton stain.
Bromodomain protein marker channel (zel031 panel only). No BRD4 anchor mechanism claim exists in this package.
Concanavalin A membrane/nucleolar stain (zel031 panel only).
A multiplexed morphology staining scan type (zel039 scantype).
Antibody-based staining of a specific target; the other zel039 scan type.
Embeddings contain the marker channels' pixels, so predicting markers from embeddings reads the answer; markers are targets, never features.
Linear regression with an L2 penalty; one of the two image-to-program model classes.
Multi-layer perceptron: a small two-hidden-layer neural network; the other image-to-program model class.
Attention over a compound's building-block tokens; the chemistry-to-program model class in the imaging annex dumps.
The shared reference-model configuration: one transformer across all contexts with library and cell-line tokens; ships in models/.
A separate model fit independently per context; the comparison arm in the benchmark tables.
The shipped checkpoints: fit with fold 0 held out, for reproducing reference scores and predicting usages for new recipes; not a production model.
models/golden_predictions.json: 20 fixed recipes with fixed expected outputs for environment verification (predict.py --check-golden).
Per-context mu/sd stored in each checkpoint; maps the raw head output back to usage units comparable to core/usages/.
The learned 64-dimensional embedding of a public BB ID in the reference model; unseen IDs map to a shared unknown row.
The pretrained 128-dimensional building-block featurization in models/bb_embedding_table.parquet.
zel031_h1650: a cell line the reference model never trained on, probed for transfer and reported as-is.
Design choice: the shared basis and usages are built on device-centered surfaces; depth handling lives in per-context targets/decoders (core/benchmark/correction_arm.csv).
The two target constructions compared in the benchmark; the device-centered target is canonical.
The heat-shock transcription factor program (HSPA1A/B, HSPA6, DNAJB1, HSPD1, HSP90AA1, ...); the flagship anchor lead ZSH-0001.
Heat-shock protein genes; the canonical gene set of the heat-shock program.
METTL3 is the m6A (N6-methyladenosine) RNA methyltransferase; its inhibitors phenocopy its knockout (ZSH-3760).
Unfolded protein response / endoplasmic-reticulum stress program (HSPA5, DDIT3, ...); the sharp SAR family ZSH-3757.

Resemblances between compound signatures in this package and CRISPR knockout signatures across 43 signature sets from 10 perturb-seq datasets, calibrated against an empirical null; hypothesis-grade. See annex_phenomimicry/.
Agreement with external atlases (CRISPR knockout panels, legacy connectivity resources); CRISPR concordance is calibrated in annex_phenomimicry/; the legacy LINCS agreement does not reproduce here.
The building-block-to-structure mapping and structure-level models are available under NDA; contact the Zafrens team.
annex_hypotheses/program_atlas.csv: the 26 program groups organizing the screens, with themes, drivers, and anchors.
annex_hypotheses/hypothesis_ledger_full.csv: the complete 1,027-row mining ledger, triage-grade.
A two-position sub-series, micro-cluster, or single-level R-group whose phenotype is sharper than its chemical neighborhood's.
A resolution-stable cluster of compounds in program space, one of the sharp-SAR candidate kinds.
